display_information.name: Sokki
display_information.description: Posts your Sokki meeting notes into the huddle's thread.
display_information.long_description: Sokki is a free, open-source meeting notetaker for the Mac that records calls locally, with no bot. After a Slack huddle it posts the summary into the huddle's thread, from your own account, with the transcript attached as a file. Audio never leaves your Mac. More at https://sokki.org
